entries.15fb9ac025f9845c: The business involves the company buying, selling and leasing real estate. It handles leased land and facilities in the Greenland Resort area. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥175 million.
entries.1dcb12629113adc5: The business involves consolidated subsidiary Ariake Resort City Co., Ltd. operating two official hotels adjacent to the amusement park, and Sorachi Resort City Co., Ltd. operating two hotels in Iwamizawa City, Hokkaido. Ariake Resort City Co., Ltd. also handles insurance agency operations for life and non-life insurance, among other activities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,958 million.
entries.200b7034e28d0494: A leisure business company centered on the "Greenland" amusement park in Arao, Kumamoto Prefecture, operating golf courses and hotels, and also handling real estate and civil engineering and construction materials.

entries.71f2bd0c7ecd5d89: The business involves consolidated subsidiary Greenland Development Co., Ltd. receiving civil engineering contracts and manufacturing, selling and transporting construction materials. It also carries out fuel feeding operations for a biomass thermal power plant. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥372 million.
entries.7c1a3efe1e1d644e: An amusement park in Arao City, Kumamoto Prefecture, operated by the company. Some of the on-site restaurants, shops and facilities are operated by consolidated subsidiaries Ariake Resort City Co., Ltd. and Greenland Development Co., Ltd., entrusted by the company. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,252 million.
entries.9799fd836a603bf1: Consolidated subsidiary Ariake Resort City Co., Ltd. operates the official hotels 'Blanca' and 'Verde', adjacent to the amusement park in Arao City, Kumamoto Prefecture. Combined revenue of the two hotels for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,401 million.

entries.ac8c65b4aa10625a: The business involves the company operating the amusement park 'Greenland' in Arao City, Kumamoto Prefecture, and consolidated subsidiary Sorachi Resort City Co., Ltd. operating and managing an amusement park and ski resort in Iwamizawa City, Hokkaido. Consolidated subsidiaries Ariake Resort City Co., Ltd. and Greenland Development Co., Ltd. are entrusted with operating food and beverage outlets, shops and facilities within the amusement park in Kyushu. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,860 million.
entries.ae46712e18e764a9: Consolidated subsidiary Sorachi Resort City Co., Ltd. operates the Hokkaido Greenland amusement park and the ski resort 'Hokkaido Greenland White Park' in Iwamizawa City, Hokkaido. It has also been designated by Iwamizawa City as designated manager, carrying out the operation and management of the facilities in Iwamizawa Park. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥608 million.
entries.b6f177e87f6e3502: Consolidated subsidiary Sorachi Resort City Co., Ltd. operates 'Hokkaido Greenland Hotel Sunplaza' in Iwamizawa City, Hokkaido, and it has also been designated by Iwamizawa City as designated manager, carrying out the operation and management of Kitamura Onsen Hotel. Combined revenue of the two hotels for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥557 million.
